question.prompt: An isosceles triangle has an angle of \(60^\circ\). Must it be an equilateral triangle?

solutions.explanation: When the \(60^\circ\) angle is the vertex angle, each base angle is \(60^\circ\). When the \(60^\circ\) angle is a base angle, the other base angle is also \(60^\circ\), and the vertex angle is \(60^\circ\).
